title: A clarinet on the Mutt Carey recordings
summary: Hall used an A clarinet once, for the Mutt Carey Scott Joplin rag recordings, and never used C-sharp or E-flat instruments.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Did you ever use an A clarinet or just everything on B flat usually?
No, I used one A clarinet and that was, I made a recording with, with Mud Carey. You know, about 67 years ago. Yeah, those rags.
Choplin rags. Choplin rags. And I had to use an A clarinet and I had a time finding one. I finally got one. And we made a recording with an A clarinet.
What about C clarinet in E class?
